messages:
Mira: Heads-up — the JS SDK sample app referenced in /docs is failing on edge runtimes after the package exports change landed. sample app CI shows import errors: https://ci.redwood/abc123 :eyes:
Tom: Repro'd locally on a Cloudflare Worker: import fails with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED for @redwood/inference. stack says package exports only expose ./dist/index.mjs so require() consumers blow up.
Erik: That's from the exports map change in PR #1234 — we replaced the dual-entry with a single ESM entry to simplify things. Didn't realize a few downstream samples still use require() or older bundlers.
Laura: Edge runtimes (CF, Fastly, V8 isolates) prefer ESM so that part is fine, but Node apps (and many sample apps) still do const r = require('@redwood/inference') or use older bundlers that resolve main/module. We should provide both import and require paths in exports.
Sam: Quick compatible exports snippet that fixes both:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
},
"main": "dist/index.cjs",
"module": "dist/index.mjs",
"types": "dist/index.d.ts"
```
Tom: Adding main/module/types helps bundlers too. Also watch out for consumers bundling the whole package.json — we expose ./package.json to allow some tooling to read version/exports.
Mira: Can we ship that as a quick patch (v0.12.1) and then follow up with a policy/CI test so we don't regress?
Sam: I'll open a PR to add the require path + types + package.json export and add two smoke tests: a tiny Node14 require-based app and a Cloudflare Worker import check. Drafting now.
Deploy-bot: rollback/patch pipeline triggered: rollback initiated for 2026-03-21T14:20Z, candidate patch v0.12.1 will include exports compat. Link: https://deploy.redwood/patches/456
Laura: Also update the sample app to import(...) where appropriate and note edge-only recommendations in the docs. We should call out Node vs Edge compatibility in the migration guide.
Erik: Heads-up that shipping both .cjs and .mjs increases package size slightly; fine for now but we should run `npm pack` and verify tarball size and compressions. Long-term we can publish a lightweight edge-only build under a different entry if needed.
Tom: Filing INF-934 for adding package export compatibility tests to our release checklist and CI matrix (node versions + edge test harness).
Mira: Great. @Sam can you ping this thread when the PR is ready? :thumbsup:
Sam: Yep — will post PR link in ~10m and tag reviewers.
Mira: Thanks everyone, we'll re-run docs/samples smoke after the patch lands and confirm Dedicated/Private deployments are unaffected. :shipit:
